ruledOutDirections.text: `.skilled/CROSS-CLI.md` is the only `CROSS-CLI.md` in the repository (there is none at the root). It is a cross-CLI dispatch doc, not an agent-inventory doc; its agent references are dispatch examples rather than role or tool claims.

`AGENTS.md` carries no per-agent inventory: its only agent section is §9 "AGENT ROUTING" at line 280, which names runtime directories generically and makes no role, tool or count claim. There is nothing there to contradict, so `AGENTS.md` is not a productive target for this topic.

Counting the CLI bridges as an agent-inventory error: `README.md:69`'s "Eight CLI bridges" resolves correctly against `.skilled/skills/cli-external-orchestration/mode-registry.json`, which declares exactly eight `workflow` modes (`cli-opencode`, `cli-claude-code`, `cli-codex`, `cli-cursor`, `cli-devin`, `cli-pi`, `cli-deepseek-harness`, `cli-mistral-vibe`). Not a finding.

Treating `.claude/agents/Explore.md` as an undocumented twelfth agent: `.claude/README.md:41` documents it ("plus `Explore.md`, which only Claude has") and `check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs:40` carries it in `CLAUDE_ONLY_AGENTS`. Not a finding.

Treating `.skilled/agents/README.txt`'s model-pin claim as wrong: the claim that the Claude tree pins `context`, `markdown` and `Explore` to haiku and `prompt-improver` to sonnet matches `.claude/agents/*.md` exactly. Not a finding.

`.skilled/agents/orchestrate.md`'s three generated blocks (`routing-table` at line 76, `tier-table` at line 98, `agent-files` at line 171) match `agent-registry.json` exactly, including the eleven priorities and the LEAF/ORCHESTRATOR split. The generator is in sync.

`.skilled/commands/deep/research.md` makes no per-agent role, tool or status claim: it is a thin router that explicitly refuses to dispatch (lines 13-14, 24, 31) and defers every agent claim to the workflow YAML. Nothing there to contradict.

`.skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/SKILL.md`'s mode table (lines 28-31) names only `deep-research` and `deep-review` as agents, which is correct for a two-mode hub; the council is correctly called out as standalone at line 33. Not a finding.

Treating `ai-council`'s `task: allow` as a LEAF violation: `.skilled/agents/ai-council.md:38-47` defines an explicit Depth 0 / Depth 1 split, where seats are dispatched only when the prompt states operator invocation and Depth 1 refuses nested dispatch. The permission is consistent with the agent's own contract, so the registry's flat `LEAF` tier is a simplification rather than a contradiction.

Treating `review`'s `bash: allow` as contradicting its "READ-ONLY file access" claim: `.skilled/agents/review.md:110` scopes Bash to `git diff`, `git log` and `gh pr view`, which are read-only commands. Not a finding.

Treating the deep-research status enum as wrong: `.skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/deep-research/SKILL.md:225` lists all six values and matches `.skilled/agents/deep-research.md`. Only the deep-review sibling is short a value.

`.skilled/commands/doctor/runtime-mirrors.md:59` describes the roster check only as "the agent roster" without naming a runtime count or a canonical tree, so the command doc itself carries no contradictable claim. The misdescription lives in the script it invokes.

The feature catalogs are not a productive surface for this topic. Of the thirteen catalog files that mention an `agents/` path, only the two iteration-dispatch files make an agent claim, and both are accurate. The remaining eleven reference agent paths as evidence links rather than as role, tool or status claims.

Treating `pause-sentinel-halt.md:110`'s citation of `.skilled/agents/deep-research.md:43-55` as stale: those lines are the ILLEGAL NESTING AND SCOPE LOCK block, which is what the row claims to anchor. Not a finding.

Treating the `.cursor`/`.devin` symlink claim as wrong: `ls -la` confirms `.cursor/agents/*.md` and `.devin/agents/*/AGENT.md` are symlinks into `.claude/agents/`. Only the OpenCode/Codex half of that sentence is wrong.

Treating the feature catalogs as a misdescription surface: the two catalogs that name an agent — `deep-research/feature-catalog/loop-lifecycle/iteration-dispatch.md` and `deep-review/feature-catalog/loop-lifecycle/iteration-dispatch.md` — describe the LEAF contract, the reducer boundary and the file locations correctly, and `deep-research/feature-catalog/feature-catalog.md:54` matches the workflow. No finding.
